notes.text: The page begins mid-proof. The manuscript discusses empty E1 and E2, invokes an excluded identity of two binary decompositions, and concludes unique determination of Sigma1+ and Sigma2+. Written intersection, comparison signs and indices were transcribed; the proof was not independently checked.

Two copies of an inclusion chain have arrows pointing from E1 and E2 toward their neighboring Sigmas. A single three-mark stroke precedes the lower chain. NB records two amalgam formulas, with E2 in the first amalgam subscript and E1 in the second. Earlier marks survive beneath the second left index and right Sigma.

The diagonal note discusses equalities among four signed Sigma sets, writes non pas ... ni ... mais, then qui équivaut à and et entraîne. The author's own words On ne veut pas exclure ce cas precede revised terminology ending non parallèles. It contains no explicit proof-check request or date. Detached point, above-Sigma mark and final high circle/zero remain uncertain.

The lower paragraph proposes studying finite indexed families of pairwise non-parallel binary decompositions of X. The adjective after finis remains spelling-uncertain and is preserved. Cancelled mathematical drafts accompany the live paragraph. The closing noun has initial fl and two p descenders: floppées.

Only faint pencil 26 appears in the lower left, recorded as archive numbering. No title, date or author's page number is visible here. Other-scan summaries at the foot of C_context.md were excluded from the evidence.

Mathematical reading cues were restricted to repeated local shapes: E subscripts, 12 on one lower level, 1 and 2 indices, crossed-oval empty set, and the repeated hooked arrows. Expected grammar did not replace equals with même or add a slash to an equality. Expected notation did not erase the detached point or decide circle versus zero.
